title: PersonaFile
description: A collection of personas — either all external (PER-001 to PER-012) or all internal (PER-050 to PER-062) — for a UK commercial bank. Captures who interacts with the bank's capabilities, how they access them, and at what volume.

group.description: Whether this file covers external or internal personas.

description.description: Brief description of this persona group.

id.description: Unique persona identifier. External: PER-001 to PER-012. Internal: PER-050 to PER-062.

name.description: Short display name for the persona.

type.description: Whether this persona is external to the bank (customer, partner, regulator) or internal (staff, system).

description.description: Narrative description of who this persona is, their goals, and their relationship to the bank.

capability_touchpoints.description: List of capability IDs (e.g. CAP-001) that this persona directly interacts with or is materially affected by.

access_classification.description: Access tier governing what data and functions this persona can reach.

channels.description: Channels through which this persona interacts with the bank.

frequency.description: Typical interaction frequency with the bank's capabilities.

volume_estimate.description: Order-of-magnitude estimate of population size or annual transaction volume for this persona in the UK market.
